description: Needs the phone link: the person signs in with the 6-digit code from the Kitchen Timer app (⋯ → Link an agent). Save a recipe — a meal with ordered steps the cook follows on the phone, each step able to start its own timer — or edit one. Give the steps as pasted text (`text`, one step per numbered line or paragraph), as a link to a recipe page (`url`), or as `steps`. A time written in a step ("roast for 45 minutes"; a range like "2-3 hours" takes the upper end) becomes that step's timer, the same as pasting it into the app. Saving never starts anything. To edit, name the recipe in `recipe`: fields you leave out keep their value; `text`, `url` or `steps` REPLACE all the steps (a run in progress keeps its place).

emoji.description: Icon on the recipe card. Defaults to a plate.

name.description: Recipe name. Required when creating from text or steps; from a link it defaults to the page's title.

recipe.description: Id or name of an existing recipe to EDIT (see read_recipes). Omit to create a new one.

steps.description: Steps given directly. Use this when you have already split the recipe yourself.

duration.description: Give the step a timer of this length, with a unit: '15m', '1h30m'. Omit for a step with no timer.

text.description: The full instruction, if the title is not enough.

title.description: Short step name, e.g. 'Boil the potatoes'.

summary.description: One short line describing the dish.

text.description: The recipe steps pasted as text: numbered or bulleted lines, else paragraphs. Times in a step become that step's timer.

url.description: A web address of a recipe page (http or https). The server reads the page's recipe data; links to private or internal addresses are refused. Ten a minute.

name: save_recipe

created.description: true = a new recipe, false = an existing one was edited.

delivery.description: How recently the phone checked in, so you never imply it has seen this.

lastSyncAgo.description: Last sync in words, e.g. '2m ago'.

notified.description: A push about this change went out.

recipe.description: The recipe: id, name, step and timer counts, whether a run is in progress.

warnings.description: Things worth saying out loud that are not failures.

title: Save or edit a recipe
